+## What
+The built client model has two parts that update.md does not list: `CompactionEntry` (an unstable ACP compaction update, with `compactionId` and `hasReportedStatus`) and `SessionNotice` (an unstable notice with `severity`, `title`, `description`, `meta`, and `SessionModel.dismissNotice(_:)`). +## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Items/CompactionAndNoticeHostedTests.swift`: the compaction row; the notice banner; the dismiss action.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
